ai_overview.text: Atopic dermatitis (eczema) treatment in Guntur is available through specialized dermatologists and multi-specialty hospitals offering medical management like topical corticosteroids, emollients, and anti-inflammatories . Notable local specialists include Dr. Kavya Chennamsetty at Leelavathi Advanced Skin and Laser Clinic in Kothapeta, Dr. Ragini Puvvala at Sri Anjani Skin Care , and dermatological departments at major facilities like Aster Ramesh Hospital . Justdial +1 Common Treatment Options Moisturizers & Emollients: Heavy creams applied frequently to rebuild the skin barrier. Topical Medications: Prescription steroid creams or calcineurin inhibitors to calm red, itchy flare-ups. Oral Medications: Antihistamines for nighttime itching or systemic drugs for severe cases. Advanced Care: Light therapy (phototherapy) or targeted biologics available via select skin clinics.
